routes.name: Rational Gram and LDL certificates
routes.outputs: A = L diag(d) L^T with d >= 0, independently reconstructed.
obligations: Every entry is rational, with no rounded float conversion.
Reconstruct the entire input matrix and check each diagonal sign.
routes.failure_check: Positive diagonal entries alone do not imply positive semidefiniteness: [[1,2],[2,1]] is indefinite.

routes.name: Rank bounds for graph constructions
routes.inputs: A graph represented by a matrix whose support is its closed neighbourhood relation.
routes.outputs: Tensor-product rank bounds and a candidate extremal family.
obligations: Verify the exact support pattern over a single common field.
Supply a construction attaining the rank bound before claiming equality.
routes.failure_check: An upper rank bound alone never proves a matching lower bound.

routes.name: Trace and kernel dimensions over finite fields
routes.inputs: A linearised polynomial over a specified finite field.
routes.outputs: Exact kernel conditions and a character-sum counting identity.
obligations: Derive the kernel equivalence for every parameter.
Check the small exceptional dimensions separately and justify the all-dimension estimate.
routes.failure_check: Enumeration in small fields is not a proof for every odd extension degree.

routes.name: Exact final-prime completion
routes.inputs: An ordered prime prefix and exact divisibility equations.
routes.outputs: At most the explicitly derived candidate(s) for the next prime.
obligations: Prove the algebraic reduction and all denominator/sign conditions.
A full exclusion requires every possible prefix length, not a finite search cutoff.
routes.failure_check: Millions of empty finite searches do not exclude unbounded numbers of prime factors.

routes.name: Certified reflexive descent chains
routes.inputs: Exact lattice vertices and a specified complete census.
routes.outputs: A replayable upper bound on shortest descent for each covered object.
obligations: Certify each lattice cut and cover relation.
Check complete census coverage, every row group, and any external completeness assumption.
routes.failure_check: A maximum upper bound is not the exact maximum without a matching lower construction.

routes.name: Blow-up and finite-cover descent
routes.inputs: A proper algebraic map with explicit exceptional divisor and pullback/pushforward data.
routes.outputs: A transport statement for classes that are actually constructed.
obligations: Track rational versus integral coefficients and every exceptional class.
Provide an algebraic representative; do not replace it by a motivated or numerical class.
routes.failure_check: Changing a variety or passing to a cover does not create an unconstructed algebraic representative.

routes.name: Rare-event boundary-response transfer
routes.inputs: Full and restricted block laws with a uniform response estimate.
routes.outputs: A two-sided error budget between their boundary influence coefficients.
obligations: Bound derivatives or transport responses, not only bad-event probability.
Prove a retained contraction margin uniformly along the physical tuning.
routes.failure_check: A rare event can have a large derivative; deterministic gauge isometries preserve Wasserstein influence coefficients.

routes.name: Tightness with non-escaping observables
routes.inputs: Renormalized observables and a common state space at every cutoff.
routes.outputs: A candidate subsequential law with precisely stated moment transfers.
obligations: Prove uniform moment/tree bounds and a nonzero fixed-distance observable.
Establish uniqueness, locality, rotational invariance and the required positive physical gap.
routes.failure_check: Unit normalization does not prevent mass from escaping to infinite physical energy.

routes.name: One-witness vacuum verification
routes.inputs: One explicit compactification and nine precisely formulated tests.
routes.outputs: A nine-entry obligation table for the same object.
obligations: Use one common vacuum, not nine unrelated examples.
Specify moduli stabilization, hierarchies and breaking tests and prove them.
routes.failure_check: A geometric construction or vanishing index alone does not verify all physical conditions.

routes.name: Skew-spectrum determinant identities
routes.inputs: A real skew adjacency matrix with its exact nullspace.
routes.outputs: A paired-eigenvalue factorization and a rational-square candidate.
obligations: Treat the zero eigenvalue and normalizing determinant explicitly.
Justify the limiting product rather than extrapolating numerical values.
routes.failure_check: A floating determinant near zero is not a proof of singularity.

routes.name: Clifford traces and graph invariants
routes.inputs: A fixed Clifford algebra convention and graph-state sum.
routes.outputs: An exact trace identity compatible with the four-term relation.
obligations: Track normalizations, signs and exceptional specialization values.
Prove the identity for arbitrary diagrams before using finite tests.
routes.failure_check: Agreement on small chord diagrams alone does not prove an all-diagram identity.

routes.name: Finite support for monotone coverage
routes.inputs: A compact polytope and functions sharing a convex part with affine differences.
routes.outputs: A finite candidate support set reusable for monotone failure rules.
obligations: Check the common convex-part hypothesis on every target face.
A support theorem needs attainment and a matching design certificate for optimization.
routes.failure_check: A finite grid need not contain the weakest coverage point.

routes.name: Deletion-contraction with an explicit cost ledger
routes.inputs: A graph or constraint family with a costed branching recurrence.
routes.outputs: An exact recurrence and a candidate subexponential algorithm on its proved parameter range.
obligations: Solve the recurrence with all density/constraint parameters retained.
Prove a reduction and worst-case bound before claiming a complexity separation.
routes.failure_check: An exponent that grows with the number of constraints cannot be silently declared uniform.

routes.name: Elimination with exceptional-locus accounting
routes.inputs: An ideal over an exact field with stated denominators and exceptional sets.
routes.outputs: Elimination or saturation certificates for a specified algebraic implication.
obligations: Retain every denominator-zero branch and distinguish radical from ordinary ideal membership.
Give exact combination witnesses; analytic or arithmetic existence is a separate step.
routes.failure_check: Dividing by a parameter can delete precisely the solutions one is trying to exclude.

scope: Planning routes carry hypotheses; only exact-psd has a new executable certificate checker in this revision.
